thread:
omar: Quick heads-up  I opened a docs PR to add a small compatibility note to the Nebula3B card about adapter-based fine-tuning artifacts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/860

jess: What do you mean by artifacts? can you paste the sentence?

omar: Sure: "Note: models fine-tuned with adapter layers may produce slightly different tokenization boundary behavior in few-shot prompts; we recommend validating prompt templates when using adapter-based customizations."

ria: Can we make that more actionable? maybe call out an example case and how to test. E.g., show a prompt where the adapter caused a leading space issue and a quick assert snippet.

omar: Good idea. I added a tiny example and an assert:```python
resp = client.generate(model="nebula3b", input="Summarize: Hello world")
assert not resp.text.startswith(" ")
```

jess: Also add a link to the adapter fine-tuning guide and a note that this does not affect hosted fp16 variants without adapters.

omar: Added both.

ci-bot: Documentation lint running for PR #860.

ria: One more thing: the compatibility note should live under "compatibility notes" not "known-issues". Can you move it?

omar: Done. Moved section and updated TOC.

jess: LGTM. Merging after green CI.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #860  merging.

omar: merged. filed ticket to add an automated doc check to ensure adapter compatibility notes are present for adapter-enabled models.
